feedback: Accepted. Format: the REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES headers are present and paper-conformant; FINAL_STATES: u3 is nonempty, u3 is declared in STATES, and it is accepting for the task (target_picked_up is the episode-ending mission-box pickup, so u3 cannot be reached before the episode terminates). Semantic fidelity: the RM encodes the base objective (eventually pick up the target box, required for u3) plus the conditional obligation 'open the door if you pick up the key': holding the key is state u1, and dropping the key before the door opens fires the one-step key_lost event, which explicitly regresses to u0 with a -0.2 penalty — the required explicit regression for the key-carrying commitment. The 0.1/0.3/1.0 ladder rewards each ordered milestone (key, door, box), and door credit is granted only via u1→u2, i.e., opening with the matching key in hand, which is also the only way the environment allows it. Reachability: u0→u1→u2→u3 is realizable and matches the seed-0 trace; the post-door_open drop correctly draws no penalty because key_lost is false when the door is open and u2 ignores key_lost via else. Compactness: 4 states is minimal — u1 and u2 cannot be merged, since dropping the key after the door opens must not be penalized. Coverage: every state has a per-state else self-loop absorbing irrelevant valuations (door re-shut/re-opened in u2, key re-pickup in u2, has_door_key persisting in u1, absorbing u3); key_lost is correctly treated as an event while door_open, has_door_key, and target_picked_up behave as conditions with re-fires absorbed by self-loops; u1's door_open and key_lost triggers are mutually exclusive by domain constraints, so there is no within-state ambiguity. Reward safety: all rewards are bounded (-0.2 to 1.0) with the final reward largest; no farming loop exists — u0→u1→u0 nets -0.1 per cycle, u2 can never re-enter u1 to re-earn the 0.3, and a toggled-shut door in u2 cannot fake u3 because the box is unreachable, so any target_picked_up in u2 is genuine. Minor non-blocking note: in u2, dropping the key after the door has been shut again is unpunished (progress banked); this is a defensible reading because the door-open obligation was already discharged and reopening requires no key.
